summary: Backend-only testing for the new public CSV template download endpoint GET /api/templates/products.csv. Wrote a new focused test module (test_csv_template.py) with 7 endpoint tests + 2 regression tests. All 9 new tests pass and the full existing suite (41 tests in test_freshcuts_api.py) continues to pass — grand total 50/50 green. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~695 lines (models + routes + seed data). Consider splitting seed data into a separate module (e.g. backend/seed_data.py) to keep server.py under 700 lines per project guidelines. Non-blocking, style-only.

PRODUCT_CSV_TEMPLATE is defined as a module-level constant which is fine; the endpoint correctly uses fastapi.responses.Response with media_type='text/csv' and an explicit Content-Disposition header. Clean, minimal implementation.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are read-only against the public CSV endpoint and existing seeded products/boxes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The CSV template endpoint at GET /api/templates/products.csv is fully verified as public (no auth required), returns Content-Type: text/csv, Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="freshcuts_products_template.csv", header row exactly matches 'name,category,available_cuts,available_weights,price,base_unit,description,image,tags', and contains 10 data rows (>=5). Regression checks on /api/products and /api/subscriptions/boxes pass. Full pytest suite runs in ~4.7s.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this was a feature verification, not a bug fix. The bug fix (CSV template download) is confirmed working end-to-end at the API layer. Frontend wiring to this endpoint was explicitly out of scope per the request.
